card.name: Nationwide and -wide scope words
card.fires_on: The word "wide" or a whole-area word like Nationwide or statewide, where a place or group is followed by -wide to mean across all of it. Seen in news, university and research text.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Nationwide
modes.description: The word Nationwide begins a sentence as an adverb giving a country-level statistic or trend.

modes.label: -wide after a place or group
modes.description: The "-wide" ending is attached to a noun such as nation, university, county or genome.
